goods_not_received.title: Goods or services not received
goods_not_received.description: Cardholder claims the goods or services were never received.

order_confirmation.description: Proof that the order was placed and confirmed by the merchant.

delivery_tracking.description: Tracking record showing the shipment was dispatched and in transit.

delivery_signature.description: Proof that the item was physically delivered and received.

customer_communication.description: Any communication with the customer regarding the order or delivery.

transaction_metadata.description: Payment and transaction details matching the disputed charge.

product_not_as_described.title: Product or service not as described
product_not_as_described.description: Cardholder claims the product or service differed materially from what was advertised.

product_description.description: Original product listing or service description at time of purchase.

customer_communication.description: Communication showing the merchant addressed the complaint.

return_policy.description: Merchant return or refund policy communicated to the customer.

refund_not_processed.title: Credit not processed
refund_not_processed.description: Cardholder claims a refund was promised but never credited.

refund_policy.description: Merchant refund policy stating timelines and conditions.

refund_timeline.description: Record showing when the refund was initiated and its current status.

customer_communication.description: Communication acknowledging the refund request and timeline.

transaction_metadata.description: Original transaction details linked to the refund.

merchant_terms.description: Merchant terms and conditions covering refund eligibility.

unauthorized_fraud.title: Fraud or unauthorized transaction
unauthorized_fraud.description: Cardholder claims the transaction was not authorized by them.

customer_history.description: Prior purchase history from the same customer showing a pattern of legitimate use.

ip_device_logs.description: Device and IP information at the time of transaction matching the cardholder.

authentication_signal.description: Evidence of authentication at the time of purchase.

transaction_metadata.description: Transaction details confirming the charge was processed correctly.

customer_communication.description: Any communication from the customer prior to the dispute.

duplicate_charge.title: Duplicate processing
duplicate_charge.description: Cardholder claims they were charged more than once for the same transaction.

original_transaction_id.description: The original transaction ID for the legitimate charge.

duplicate_transaction_comparison.description: Side-by-side comparison showing the two transactions are distinct.

settlement_record.description: Settlement or reconciliation record showing only one charge was intended.

customer_communication.description: Any communication with the customer about the charge.
